item.title: Manibusan sweeps Ace titles at season opener
item.description: THE Saipan Golf Association kicked off its 2026 season with a display of veteran precision at LaoLao Bay Golf & Resort’s East Course, where Ed Manibusan emerged as the standout performer, capturing the prestigious SGA 2025 Ace of Aces title while also clinching the January 2026 Ace of the Month crown on Jan. 18. The post Manibusan sweeps Ace titles at season opener appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Shadowy video, first known arrest mark big breaks in Nancy Guthrie abduction
item.description: TUCSON, Arizona (Reuters) — Authorities on Tuesday released video of an armed man in a ski mask tampering with the doorbell camera at the Arizona home of U.S. television journalist Savannah Guthrie's elderly mother shortly before she was abducted nine days earlier in a presumed kidnapping for ransom. The post Shadowy video, first known arrest mark big breaks in Nancy Guthrie abduction appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: US bars Palau Senate president, former Marshall Islands mayor from entry
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — The United States on Tuesday barred Palau Senate President Hokkons Baules and his family from entering the U.S., accusing him of corruption linked to China, as Washington pushes back on Beijing's effort to boost its influence in the Pacific. The post US bars Palau Senate president, former Marshall Islands mayor from entry appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Finance now accepts DPL payments
item.description: (DOF) — The Department of Finance is now accepting payments on behalf of the Department of Public Lands. This update is part of a government-wide initiative to streamline financial operations, enhance accountability, and ensure compliance with fiscal management requirements. The post Finance now accepts DPL payments appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: House passes electronic transaction bill

item.title: DPL: Marianas Beach Resort ‘fully up to date’ on some payments
item.description: THE Marianas Beach Resort has met some of its obligations to the CNMI government, Department of Public Lands Secretary Sixto Igisomar told the Senate Committee on Resources, Economic Development and Workforce during a meeting Tuesday.
